set.body: Export the source identity graph in a checked, versioned form (codec) that the Python connected assessor can read, and make the assessor validator take identity and continuity from it instead of per-question same_entity/same_situation edges. Turns the S1 expectedFailure cases for S2 and S3 into passing witnesses. May fold into S5 if S5 owns the validator change.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3d] Export the source graph and make the assessor consume it
